native_tiny_reads.purpose: Re-read 10-byte index descriptor; compare generation, invalidate index state on change
native_tiny_reads.attribution: ETW file offsets matched to K directory; matching CPU stacks and static code. Full-request speedup from eliminating these reads was not measured.

controls_note: 30 held getfile connections. The LAN-address probe still runs on the server itself. An immediate native burst had three ConnectionRefusedError; a later 30-ms-staggered control passed 30/30. The cause of that burst failure and remote reserve classification were not isolated.
measurement_build_note: The implementation was load-tested before assigning release version 0.28.2. Run exe_sha256 values identify the measured binaries. Published package hashes are in the release SHA256SUMS.

search.note: Separate diagnostic series with KODEKS_PROFILE and SQL trace. Only the first request starts with cold process caches; OS caches are not flushed. Later queries reuse data.

throughput.attribution: Grouped completion is observed. Exact blocking cause of each trough is not established; the early burst is outside the captured mixed ETW window.

codex_ais_deletions.note: The second cascade waited in the queue. Both ran sequentially on worker 5. Total HTTP time includes queueing; the gap between replies is not an isolated execution-time measurement. Cache contribution was not separately measured.
